items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: But it's Buddy Bolden days. But I know, yes, I did get the scene. When I got the scene, he was paralyzed.

ctx.x: They said that about Buddy Bolden, too.

And there's another trumpet player. I didn't get the scene. But it's Buddy Bolden days. But I know, yes, I did get the scene. When I got the scene, he was paralyzed. And they say a woman told him he was going to kick her down the step in the condom home. And she told him if he kicked her down the step, he'll never use that arm and hand no more. And that's the truth. That leg either. He kicked her down the dog if he wasn't. Got a fella I've drunk ever since. Some old trumpet player. I don't know who he was. Yes, I…
Was he from Uptown or down?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Buddy used to lead that stuff, man. ... he got it from Buddy, he started it.

ctx.x: Well, Buddy couldn't go enough for a G, you know.
No, how loud would he get?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I heard about Uncle Bud already.

ctx.x: Well, what do you call that fella sitting next to you? My uncle. Uncle what? Punch. He called you Uncle Bud, too. Yeah, yeah. I heard about Uncle Bud already. How do you spell your last name, Lionel?
